items.article_text: hi! im new to cds but im a huge music person. My parents are both pretty into music, especially my dad, who has a similar taste in music to me. i asked them if they still had any cds and they both pulled out their collections! i spent forever laying them out (last pic) but i like a lot of the artists they have. my dad has almost all of the albums of some bands we both like (alice in chains, nirvana, pearl jam, etc.) and a lot more rock in general. my mom has some rock albums, but more pop and varied genres. i‘m currently using a dvd holder to hold them but im looking for a display specifically for cds at thrift shops and stuff. i figured this will work for now. my car has a cd player so ive been using that, and am looking for a cd player for my room. id rather not spend a ton of money—henc
